title: shulker.lock
description: Shulker lock file. Tool-owned, key-sorted, pretty-printed. Records the exact resolution of shulker.json; install and build read only this file.

minecraft.description: Resolved Minecraft version id, exactly as Mojang's manifest names it.

loader.description: The resolved mod loader. Omitted when the project has no loader.

version.description: Resolved loader version, exactly as the loader's meta names it.

provides.description: Mod ids the loader jar provides, with their versions, e.g. the fabricloader version the Quilt loader stands in for. Validation treats them as installed.

client.description: NeoForge, Forge: the installer jar, locked the first time `link mojang` runs its client install. The client libraries the installer downloads itself stay unlocked, like the files Fabric's launcher fetches.

server.description: Server launcher, present once the server side has been installed.

installer.description: Fabric: installer version whose bundled server launcher is locked.

url.description: Download url of the jar in sha512. The quilt-server-launch.jar shulker generates has none.

sha512.description: The server launch jar: Fabric's bundled launcher, or the quilt-server-launch.jar shulker generates. NeoForge and Forge: their installer jar, which shulker runs offline into each server dir that doesn't have this loader version yet.

libraries.description: Quilt: the loader's libraries. NeoForge and Forge: every library their installer would download, so it runs offline. Keyed by Maven coordinate, placed under libraries/.

major.description: javaVersion.majorVersion from the Mojang version json, or the override's major.

component.description: Mojang runtime component name, e.g. java-runtime-epsilon. Used to fetch the managed runtime.

server.description: The vanilla server jar, present once the server side has been installed. Fabric's launcher finds it in .fabric/server/, Quilt's starts it as server.jar, and the NeoForge and Forge installers patch it from libraries/.

modpacks.description: Every modpack in the manifest's requires, keyed by its requires key.

mods.description: Every mod in the resolved set, direct and transitive, keyed by its requires key or, for a dependency, its in-jar mod id.

resourcepacks.description: Every resource pack in the resolved set, keyed by its requires key. The build places each as resourcepacks/<key>.zip.

shaders.description: Every shader in the resolved set, keyed by its requires key. The build places each as shaderpacks/<key>.zip, or resourcepacks/<key>.zip when it targets vanilla core shaders.

players.description: Every player referenced anywhere in the manifest, fully resolved. uuid is the identity across renames.

provider.description: The provider a hosted modpack was locked from. Hosted modpacks only.

project.description: Provider project id, typed as the provider types it. Hosted modpacks only.

version.description: Provider version id (Modrinth) or file id (CurseForge). Hosted modpacks only.

versionNumber.description: Provider display string. Never parsed. Hosted modpacks only.

channel.description: Least stable channel accepted when this version was picked. Hosted modpacks only.

url.description: The archive's download url. null when the author disabled third-party distribution; page is then required. Hosted modpacks only.

page.description: Provider file page for manual download. Present only when url is null.

filename.description: The provider's name for the archive. Hosted modpacks only.

source.description: The manifest source at resolution time. A different source in the manifest makes the lock out of date.

ref.description: The manifest ref at resolution time. Git sources only.

dirSha256.description: Content hash of the modpack's shulker.json and override directories in sorted path order, excluding its lock, build output, and data. Local-path sources only.

sha256.description: Hash of the fetched manifest. Raw manifest URL sources only.

file.description: A local modpack archive: the path shulker.json gives it. Its sha512 is its identity and its key in the cache.

sha512.description: Hash of the archive's bytes, its identity and its key in the cache. Archives, local or hosted, only.

size.description: The archive's length, compared before rehashing a local one. Archives only.

unmanaged.description: The files the archive lays as its own overrides, by layer and path, each with its sha512: files in its index no provider matched, and jars and pack zips in its override folders no lock entry took. The build lays these and the archive's other override files, and nothing else. Archives only.

locked.description: Present when the modpack's mods were copied from its lock. Absent means they were resolved from its manifest.

lockSha256.description: Hash of the modpack's lock at resolution time. Present exactly when locked is, on a source modpack.

file.description: A local file: the path shulker.json gives it. Such an entry names no provider, and its sha512 is its identity.

project.description: Provider project id, typed as the provider types it.

version.description: Provider version id (Modrinth) or file id (CurseForge).

url.description: Download url. null when the author disabled third-party distribution; page is then required.

page.description: Provider file page for manual download. Present only when url is null.

sha512.description: Cache key and install verification hash.

size.description: Jar size in bytes as the provider reports it, for the download bar; for a local file, its length, compared before rehashing it. Absent on entries locked before shulker recorded sizes; filled in when the mod is next resolved.

side.description: Effective side after any manifest override.

channel.description: Least stable channel accepted when this version was picked: the manifest's channel for a mod listed there or in a pack, the requiring mod's for a dependency. A listed mod whose manifest channel differs makes the lock out of date.

modpack.description: Key in modpacks of the locked modpack this entry was copied from. Absent for the project's own mods and the dependencies resolved for them.

modId.description: The jar's in-jar mod id. Present only when it differs from the entry's key; dependency matching and validation use it, while requiredBy and every other reference use the key.

slug.description: The provider's project slug. Present only when it differs from the entry's key; a recommends, suggests or optional dependency naming it is reported as installed under the key, though the loader does not match it.

requiredBy.description: Requires keys of the mods, or modpacks, that depend on this mod. Empty plus absent from the manifest's requires and every modpack means orphan.

aliases.description: The same mod's project id on other providers, discovered on first download.

file.description: A local file: the path shulker.json gives it. Such an entry names no provider, and its sha512 is its identity.

project.description: Provider project id, typed as the provider types it.

version.description: Provider version id (Modrinth) or file id (CurseForge).

filename.description: The name the build places the file under: the manifest entry's filename, or <key>.zip. Either way it stays put across updates, so a pack enabled in game stays enabled.

providerFilename.description: The provider's own name for the file. The CurseForge app saves a pack under it, so a CurseForge export enables the pack by it.

url.description: Download url. null when the author disabled third-party distribution; page is then required.

page.description: Provider file page for manual download. Present only when url is null.

sha512.description: Cache key and install verification hash.

sha1.description: The provider's sha1 of the file, or one computed over its bytes when the provider gives none. A server pushes it to clients as resource-pack-sha1. Provider packs only.

size.description: File size in bytes as the provider reports it, for the download bar; for a local file, its length, compared before rehashing it.

channel.description: Least stable channel accepted when this version was picked. A listed entry whose manifest channel differs makes the lock out of date.

modpack.description: Key in modpacks of the locked modpack this entry was copied from. Absent for the project's own entries.

loader.description: Shaders only: the shader loader this file targets. vanilla shaders are core-shader resource packs, placed in resourcepacks/ and enabled like one; the rest are placed in shaderpacks/ and enabled through their shader mod's own .properties file.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the project root, forward slashes, no leading slash.

resolvedAt.description: When this name/uuid pair was last confirmed against Mojang.
